params.caption: 🕹️ Nintendo hits GitHub with a wave of Switch emulator takedowns Nintendo has filed four DMCA takedown notices with GitHub. They target two Switch emulators, Yuzu and Citron Neo, as well as firmware for Switch mod chips. It is the latest step in Nintendo's long fight against emulation and console modding. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 23:14 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN ⚖️ Fair move or too far? React 👍 or 👎 · 💬 Drop your take below #Nintendo #Switch #GamingNews
